welcome.heading: Welcome to Streaming Tree for OBS
welcome.flow: OBS sends one stream to Streaming Tree for OBS, which distributes it to your destinations - Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok - and powers chat, alerts, overlays and other engagement tools alongside it.
welcome.standalone: Streaming Tree is a standalone companion application, not an OBS plugin. It never modifies your OBS installation or its configuration files - OBS simply points one output at it, like any other streaming destination.
welcome.expectation: This short assistant explains what to check and where to find it. You can skip it at any time and reopen it later from Settings.

summary.heading: You're ready to go
summary.body: Setup is complete. You can always come back to this assistant from Settings if you want a refresher.
